name: ANM_DISPATCH_BOUND__OPCODE_MAX_35
comment: CMP DL,0x23 / JA: opcodes above 35 fall through to the advance tail. No shipped .anm uses an opcode >= 36.

name: ANM_CASE_18_19_20__POS_TIME_INTERP
comment: Shared handler for PosTimeLinear/Decel/Accel; they differ only in flag bits.

name: ANM_CASE_23__ANCHORTOPLEFT
comment: AND [vm+0xc4],0xfffffcff / OR [vm+0xc4],0x400 -> anchor field 4 = (left, top). Zero-argument, absolute assignment.

name: ANM_CASE_32__ANCHORTOPCENTER
comment: AND [vm+0xc4],0xfffffbff / OR [vm+0xc4],0x300 -> anchor field 3 = (center, top). Zero-argument, absolute assignment.

name: ANM_CASE_33__ANCHORLEFT
comment: AND [vm+0xc4],0xfffff9ff / OR [vm+0xc4],0x100 -> anchor field 1 = (left, center). Zero-argument, absolute assignment.

name: ANM_CASE_35__ANCHORRIGHT
comment: AND [vm+0xc4],0xfffffaff / OR [vm+0xc4],0x200 -> anchor field 2 = (right, center). Zero-argument, absolute assignment.

name: ANM_CASE_34__ANCHORTOPRIGHT
comment: AND [vm+0xc4],0xfffffdff / OR [vm+0xc4],0x500 -> anchor field 5 = (right, top). Zero-argument, absolute assignment.

name: ANM_ADVANCE_TO_NEXT_INSTR
comment: next = current + 4 + args_size. Also the direct jump-table target for the execution-time no-ops (opcode 6 nop, opcode 22 interruptLabel).

name: ECL_OPCODE_DISPATCH
comment: Main opcode dispatch; encoded table accepts IDs 1..201.

name: ECL_CASE_67_75_201__BULLET_PATTERN
comment: Shared bullet-pattern handler. Opcode 201 reaches it with aimMode=201-67=134 (provisional semantics).

name: ECL_CASE_200__SHOOT_OFFSET_POLAR
comment: NC opcode 200: shootOffset.x=cos(arg0)*arg1, y=sin(arg0)*arg1, z=0; arg2 is unused here.

name: ECL_TIMELINE_OPCODE_DISPATCH
comment: Timeline dispatch accepts only opcodes 0..12.

name: ECL_SCAN_TIMELINE_OPCODE_13
comment: Loader scan for an opcode-13 timeline checkpoint.

name: RESULT_CHEAT__FILL_CLRD_WITH_99
comment: Writes 10 bytes of 99 at 0x1404ff100 + n*0x18 for n in 0..3.

name: RESULT_CHEAT__ENQUEUE_SOUND_1UP
comment: Enqueues sound id 0x1c (SOUND_1UP in the TH06 numbering) into g_SoundRequestQueue.

name: RESULT_STATE_6_LUNATIC__UNLOCK_CHEAT
comment: Jump-table target for state 6 (Lunatic records). Only this state calls the unlock cheats; states 3/4/5/7 enter the shared handler directly.

name: RESULT_STATE_3_TO_7__SHARED_RECORDS
comment: Shared records-page handler for result-screen states 3..7.

name: g_EclFile
comment: Loaded ECL file buffer (g_EclManager + 0x08).

name: g_EclSubTable
comment: Relocated ECL subroutine pointer table (+0x10).

name: g_EclTimelineCheckpoint
comment: Opcode-13 timeline checkpoint selected by the loader (+0x18).

name: g_EclTimelineCheckpointPending
comment: Requests use of the saved timeline checkpoint (+0x20).

name: g_KeyState
comment: 256-byte keyboard down-state array.
